info.title: Ping-pong configuration commands
info.description: Single-call JSON-RPC 2.0 over the config-rpc web trigger. Requires Authorization: Bearer <per-environment runtime secret>. Batches, notifications, positional params, and null IDs are unsupported. The peer-event endpoint does not use this credential.
